notes: Two-stage: `python solution/main.py doctor --input input` validates model files, CUDA, requests.jsonl and every referenced page image and exits 78 on any missing item (0 when ready); `python solution/main.py run --input input --output output` performs the real CUDA bf16 greedy Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct generation (max_new_tokens=512, max_pixels=262144) for every id in that order and writes output/pages/<id>.md, output/documents.jsonl (id/text/token_ids/image sha256), output/tables/*.html, output/formula_manifest.jsonl, output/page_status.jsonl, output/config.json and output/run.json with synchronized wall and CUDA-event timings, verified pixel_values-on-CUDA flags and peak GPU memory. `python solution/main.py infer --image PATH --prompt TEXT --output out.json` runs the same model on a fresh page outside the request list and stores the Markdown, token ids, image hash and timings. No CPU fallback, no mock weights, no placeholder text; any page that raises is recorded as failed and forces exit code 1 instead of being faked. Rows in run.json/report are produced by the host controller's actual execution; this listing does not claim execution.
